The requested form is a single testing.suites { ... } block per file, consistent with the cleanup already delivered in PR #21143. Replace those wrappers in each of the eleven Gradle files already changed by this PR, keeping their contents and behavior unchanged. Do not edit any other PR.

Preserve the previous attempt's scoped configureEach/configureDefault settings, genuine cross-suite Mockito agent setup, runtime flag forwarding, suite and execution registrations, task names, source sets, dependencies, filters, JVM settings, JDK gates, metadata profiles, check wiring and test coverage. Do not change agent instructions, documentation, or shared conventions. This follow-up is only the omitted wrapper syntax, not another design pass or a reason to expand scope. Format the changed Gradle files and perform narrow cloud-side validation that all eleven use testing.suites { ... } and retain the same registered tasks and settings. Do not create another PR.
